svg.text: Mountain Range: where Top 6 concentrate a ship or habit more than the Rest
Each dot is the centre of one laid smoke, team-normalized (north-spawn teams mirrored north-south). Outline = the spot (solid = signature, dashed = lead).
Signature: parked cruiser smoke, far west edge, own-side rim of the big cap A
2nd destroyer: position recorded 8 of 12, forward of the smoke 7 (20 de Julio 3).
Lead: Svea, own side of cap B, west-centre
2nd destroyer: position recorded 7 of 10, forward of the smoke 5 (20 de Julio 5).
